The Interledger community calls shall be once a month, on the second Wednesday of the month.

We’ll have 5 regular update slots from:

  • Interledger Foundation
  • Rafiki
  • Fynbos
  • Coil
  • Open Payments teams

@gFam.Live would like to explain some of the things gFam.live is doing (Challenges, tutorials, etc).
